title: Stop Saying "It's Broken": 3 Better Words #shorts
description:
Another word for broken? You borrowed your friend's car, and now it's not just broken. Here are 3 better ways to say it:
• Wrecked: badly damaged, smashed
• Totaled: too damaged to be worth fixing (informal, US)
• Beyond repair: so damaged it can't be fixed

Ever returned a car like this?

Clip: Big Business (1929)

Find another word for any word on anotherwordfor.net
